rationale: The dense signed zero-surface remains geometry authority; Stage14 selects only the minimum adequate mechanical carrier density.
128 through 8192 are search bounds, not a fixed target_nodes product truth.
The STRICT tolerance profile was the first preregistered strict-to-loose profile with a passing candidate for every subject-free calibration shape.
normal_k=64 and visibility_depth_tolerance_norm=0.02 preserve the established scene-first GSA operator settings rather than tuning them from Knight.
mutation_rule: After Knight Stage14 result inspection this policy may only be tightened prospectively; it may never be relaxed to convert a failure into PASS.
claim_boundary: This policy does not claim Knight compliance, Stage14 PASS, Stage15 PASS, or PRODUCT_PASS.
